verdict.rationale: Bruno documents importing Postman collections including a preserve-scripts option for Postman import/export, and stores collections as plain-text Bru files that can be moved via filesystem/Git. However, evidence does not show export TO Postman/OpenAPI/Insomnia formats or broader multi-tool interoperability beyond Postman import. missing for 10: documented export to other tools' formats (e.g., Postman, OpenAPI, Insomnia), evidence of round-trip fidelity, independent corroboration of import/export reliability.
